parameters.name: ASMGatewayContinue
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to continue upgrading the ASM gateway. Valid values:

- `true`: Upgrades the ASM gateway.

- `false`: Does not upgrade the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: ExpectedVersion
parameters.description: The version to which you want to upgrade the instance. If you set this parameter, the backend checks if the target version matches this expected version. The upgrade proceeds only if the versions match. If they do not match, the `UpgradedVersion.NotExpected` fault is returned.

parameters.name: PreCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a precheck. If set to true, the system performs a precheck but does not start the upgrade.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the ASM instance.

parameters.name: SwitchToPro
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to switch the instance to the Professional Edition. Valid values:

- `true`: Switches the instance to the Professional Edition.

- `false`: Does not switch the instance to the Professional Edition.

parameters.name: UpgradeGatewayRecords
parameters.description: The list of ASM gateways to upgrade. Separate multiple gateway names with commas.
